findings.title: Concurrent cold-cache callers all reload the manifest serially
findings.body: The cache is checked before acquiring the write lock, but it is not checked again after the lock is acquired. If several non-dev requests arrive while the cache is empty, each observes `nil`, waits for the previous caller to finish reading/parsing the manifest, and then performs its own file/CDN load while holding the exclusive lock. This turns one initialization load into one serialized load per concurrent request and blocks cache readers for the duration of each load. Recheck `entryPointAssetsCache` after acquiring the lock (for non-dev mode) and return it if another goroutine populated it.
